\section*{Table S7. Robustness and residual diagnostics for the 11 primary EHG9 UC--IN features}\label{tab:s7_robustness}
All values are read from saved outputs of the reviewer-revision analyses (folders 01, 02, 05--08) and the Stage 09 residual-autocorrelation diagnostic; no model was refitted for this document. The 11 features are those FDR-supported in the original EHG9 34-feature family. Coefficients are standardised UC-minus-IN estimates. Panels S7A--S7D are descriptive and are not a second inferential family.
\subsection*{S7A. Lag-1 autocorrelation of model residuals in the five most-windowed EHG9 recordings}
Residuals were ordered by window start time within each recording. Entries are Pearson lag-1 autocorrelation; an asterisk marks marginal (fixed-effects-only) residuals used because the fit had a singular random-effects covariance; bold marks $|r_1|\ge0.30$. Across the 11 features and five recordings, 25 of 55 combinations reached the informal $0.30$ flag, with a maximum $|r_1|$ of 0.560; 0 of 55 used marginal residuals. This is a diagnostic, not a model of serial correlation.
